name: module-data-validation
goal: Require complete committed module metadata for CLI and app reads; validate whole projects, types and modules with cache-safe historical backfill

evidence: CLI/app readers reconstruct transitive APIs without a committed complete module snapshot; require persisted per-module facts and scoped gap diagnostics
units check covers manifests but no committed query snapshot, cache identity or scoped historical validation. Extend standardized command and temporary-project CLI coverage.
